goals: Provide a foundational environment and common utilities for integration testing of the FAF API, including web layer interaction, security (OAuth), messaging (RabbitMQ), and data persistence.
activities: Configure the RabbitMQ container with a shared network and alias 'faf-rabbitmq'.
Set the RabbitMQ container's admin user to 'faforever' and admin password.
Enable reuse for the RabbitMQ container.
Configure Spring properties for RabbitMQ host using the container's host.
Configure Spring properties for RabbitMQ port using the container's AMQP port.
Configure Spring properties for RabbitMQ username using the container's admin username.
Configure Spring properties for RabbitMQ password using the container's admin password.
Execute SQL script 'truncateTables.sql' to clear database tables before each test method.
Execute SQL script 'prepDefaultData.sql' to populate default database data before each test method.
Set up MockMvc by building it with the web application context and applying Spring Security configuration.
Configure the ObjectMapper to exclude empty values during serialization.
Initialize the JSON:API ResourceConverter, registering various DTO classes for serialization and deserialization.
